title: Haaye Noujawan Akbar Haaye Noujawan Akbar
body:
haaye noujawa'n akber haaye noujawa'n akber
<<DIVIDER>>
dete hai sada ran me shahe karbala rokar
<<MINI>>
haaye noujawa'n akber haaye noujawa'n akber
<<DIVIDER>>
thokare'n mai khaata hu'n, kuch nazar nahi aata
na sujhayi deta hai, lasha hai tera kis jaa
do sada pidar ko ab ham shabihe paighambar
kya chhupaate ho mujhse, aye mere ali akber
<<DIVIDER>>
khaak pe tadapte ho kis liye mere dilbar
dard kaisa uttha hai haath kyu hai seene par
tu gawaah rehna aye, hum ko paalne wale
baap ye zaeefi me, noujawaan ke seene se
<<DIVIDER>>
khainchta hai barchhi ko ya ali madad kehkar
laash par pisar ki ye, shahedee'n ka tha nouha
ye zaeef kaandho'n par, noujawaan ka laasha
kis tarha se lejaye qaime me ali akber
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon se tarbatar akber, chand sa tera chehra
kistarha se dekhegi, maa batao ab beta
sadme se na marjaye teri maa ali akber
jab se tum gaye ran ko, lab pe hai yehi nouha
<<DIVIDER>>
laal hai mera tanha, aur narghaye aada
muztarib jo qaime ke dar pe hai khadi madar
noujawaa'n ka pursa do, binte fatima zehra
kehte hain ye zainab se, roke shahe karbobala
<<DIVIDER>>
khaake seene par barchhi margaya mera dilbar
dil ka tha bada armaan, byaah mai rachaungi
baandh kar tujhe sehra, dulha mai banaungi
khaak pe tadapti hai kehke zainab-e-muztar
<<DIVIDER>>
kis tarha se bhulenge, karbala ka wo manzar
giryae haram jo tha, noujawa'n ke laashe par
aaj tak bhi aati hain ye sadae'n aye anwar
